visual_review: Outlined rounded 1 like the Google One mark: round-ended stem, smooth tangent flag arm ending in a round knob; smooth joins throughout, reads as the logo at 48 in both themes (the old one was a blocky 7 with a flat, kinked base).
omissions: None; the reference is a single-outline mark. Brand colours are not part of the line icon.
